outlook.statement: The Indian technology sector is expected to surpass USD 315 billion in FY26, reflecting continued growth in digital services, engineering research and development (ER&D), cloud adoption and AI-led solutions. Direct employment in the sector is projected to reach approximately 6 million, representing 2.3% year-on-year growth.

Global ER&D spending is projected to reach USD 2.5 trillion by 2030. Indian providers are increasingly adopting full-stack delivery models and sustained platform ownership, while enterprises embed AI across core operations.

Enterprises are increasingly moving from experimentation towards scaled deployment of AI across technology operations, business processes, customer experience, application development and decision-making.
